arguments.reason: order-total is not listed under Expected, and its Decisions rows give different outcomes (auto-fix for a certain crash from a retired discount code, person when the cause is uncertain or a valid-code total would change), so the cause has to be checked first. arguments.message:
Run id: eval-order-total-1003-again-20261127-060003-triage-1. Please investigate this error in the order-service repository at demos/louis-agent/samples/order-service.

Error: service order-service, method order-total, argument 1003, System.Collections.Generic.KeyNotFoundException: "The given key 'SUMMER25' was not present in the dictionary." Stack: Dictionary get_Item called from OrderService.OrderApi.GetOrderTotal(Int32 id) in src/OrderService/Api/OrderTotal.cs:line 18; called from Program.cs:line 13 and Program.cs:line 45.

Runbook for order-total: GET /orders/{id}/total returns subtotal minus the order's discount code, rounded to 2 decimals. Discount codes in force: WELCOME10 (10%), VIP20 (20%). Marketing retires codes without telling engineering, so orders can carry a code no longer in the table. Expected: only OrderNotFoundException (404). Expected behaviour: an unknown or retired discount code gives no discount (total = subtotal) instead of failing. Totals for orders with WELCOME10, VIP20 or no code must not change.

Please find where the cause is (file and method), what the cause is in one sentence, whose area it is (code, data, hosting, third-party or unknown), and how sure you are (low, medium or high). Confirm from the code whether the lookup of the discount code is the only cause, and whether the fix would change totals for valid codes. Do not change any code. Report with ReportInvestigation.
